advisories.title: The 'Does not SATISFY' enumeration in Decision item 7 carries forward, byte-identically, the same internal asymmetry recorded at D-125 and D-126
advisories.observation: Measured against file 08 lines 283-312, the thirty slice-affecting V2 rows are DR-101 through DR-130 and comprise 4 SATISFIED (DR-102, DR-115, DR-119, DR-123), 2 DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED (DR-104, DR-118), 2 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW (DR-107, DR-122) and 22 OPEN — arithmetic that reproduces file 08's own condition-2 cell at line 403 exactly. The draft names 23 rows and produces three asymmetries. DR-115 is named although already SATISFIED, while DR-102, DR-119 and DR-123, also SATISFIED, are omitted. DR-107 is omitted although PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, while DR-122 with the identical status is named. DR-128, DR-129 and DR-130 are omitted although all three are OPEN. Diffing this draft against the adopted D-126 draft shows the enumeration is unchanged to the byte; only the surrounding 'Does not overturn' list grew, correctly, by D-032, D-035, D-125 and D-126.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: The enumeration is not the operative scope bound. 'Readiness effect: Zero. Condition 2 stays 4 of 30 SATISFIED' binds all thirty rows at once, and I verified that arithmetic independently against file 08 rather than accepting it. Critically, the subject row of this decision — DR-114 — is expressly named in the list and independently confirmed OPEN at file 08 line 296, so the one row this decision actually touches is disclaimed. The identical text sits in the ADOPTED D-125 and D-126 records, both of which cleared at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX; charging it here would contradict the precedent this draft correctly claims to follow, and I graded it advisory on the same reasoning in each of the two preceding cycles.
advisories.suggestedDisposition: Optional and not a condition of adoption. A future recording could enumerate every non-SATISFIED row, or state the bound solely by the condition-2 count and drop the enumeration.
